name: All Souls
dates: Commemoration of all the faithful departed
history: The day after All Saints the Church prays for all who have died in God's friendship but still await purification. Priests may offer three Masses today. Through November Catholics visit graves and pray for their dead.
prayer: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. May they rest in peace. Amen.
fast: From 1 to 8 November a plenary indulgence may be gained for the souls in purgatory by visiting a cemetery and praying for the dead.
meditation: Name your dead before God today, one by one.
